name: Briar Fox
text: Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the enemy player.)
flavor: Through the thorn-hedge and gone before the hounds catch the scent.

name: Hedgerow Druid
text: Tap: Add {G}.
flavor: The soil is our true mother, and the ploughman owes her an apology every spring. (Hedgerow Druid)

name: Thornback Boar
text: Whenever Thornback Boar attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: Its tusks have uprooted more saplings than any woodsman's axe.

name: Bramble Spider
text: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
flavor: Kill no spider, kill no fly, kill no wolf. Kill only the woodcutter, who is the true pest. (A Moot precept)

name: Acorn Gatherer
text: When Acorn Gatherer enters, create a 1/1 Sapling token.
flavor: Every acorn has more right to this valley than every child of man. (Acorn Gatherer)

name: Antlered Barrow-Stag
text: Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the enemy player.)
flavor: Our forefathers did not die. They became mushrooms, and one must never be rude to them. (A moot-folk saying)

name: Oakmoot Sentinel
text: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
flavor: The trees are the true judges. Men only borrow their shade to hold court. (A saying of the Moot)

name: Sett Badger
text: Regenerate {G} ({G}: The next time this creature would be destroyed this turn, instead tap it, remove all damage from it, and remove it from combat.)
flavor: Dig him out of one hole and he is already snoring in the next.

name: Barrowland Bear
text: Rooted: As long as you control six or more lands, Barrowland Bear gets +1/+1.
flavor: The druids call him grandfather, and wisely give him the path.

name: Huntsman of the Weald
text: When Huntsman of the Weald enters, create a 2/2 Wolf token.
flavor: He keeps no kennel. The wolves simply come when he whistles.

name: Horned Aurochs
text: Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the enemy player.)
flavor: Every field is a wound, and every farmer a surgeon who will not stop cutting. (A hedgerow sermon)

name: Old Hollow Oak
text: Regenerate {1}{G} ({1}{G}: The next time this creature would be destroyed this turn, instead tap it, remove all damage from it, and remove it from combat.)
flavor: Lightning is the sky's love for the oak, the druids taught. They held this view until it struck them.

name: Rag-Tree Well
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, add {G}.
flavor: Tie a rag to the thorn above the well and the well will cure you. If it does not, the rag was dirty. (A wellkeeper's teaching)

name: Wildsurge
text: Target creature you control gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
flavor: Man is a stain upon the forest. Be a beast, and be clean. (The Archdruid of the Moot)

name: Test of Antlers
text: Target creature you control fights target enemy creature. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
flavor: The forest knows no right or wrong, only stronger and weaker. The druids call this wisdom.

name: Brought to Earth
text: Destroy target enemy creature with flying.
flavor: Whatever flies must perch at last, and every perch is a branch.

name: Ivy in the Gears
text: Destroy target enemy relic.
flavor: Every engine is a sin against the leaf. The ivy is only hearing its confession. (A Moot druid)

name: Call of the Pack
text: Create two 2/2 Wolf tokens.
flavor: One howl at moonrise, and the hills answer.

name: Rowan Charm

abilities.text: {G}, Tap: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

text: {G}, Tap: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
flavor: A sprig of rowan over the byre door, and no ill thing crosses.

name: Sower's Basket
text: {1}{G}, Tap: Create a 1/1 Sapling token.
flavor: Scattered by hand in spring, gathered by the cartload in autumn.

name: Moorland Wolf
text: Moorland Wolf gets +1/+0 for each other Wolf you control.
flavor: Alone he is a thin grey shadow on the heather. He is seldom alone.

name: Ridge-Runner Wolf
text: Whenever another Wolf enters under your control, Ridge-Runner Wolf gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
flavor: He runs the skyline so the flock below can see him coming, and lose heart.

name: Run with the Pack
text: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Wolf you control.
flavor: The lone wolf starves. The pack eats in winter.

name: Coppiced Hazel
text: Tap: Add {G}.
flavor: Cut to the stool every seventh year, and every seventh year he comes back thicker.

name: Hedge-Elm of the Moot
text: Hedge-Elm of the Moot gets +1/+0 for each other Treefolk you control.
flavor: The moot voted that the elm is wiser than the elders. The elm, as usual, abstained. (Records of the Moot)

name: Stand Like Oaks
text: Treefolk you control get +2/+1 and gain trample until end of turn.
flavor: The axemen came at dawn. By noon they were sharpening their axes and wondering.

name: Dusk-Runner Wolf
text: Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the enemy player.)
flavor: Shepherds bar the fold at sunset. He was over the wall at noon.

name: Bark-Skin
text: When Bark-Skin enters, put two +0/+1 counters on target creature you control. That creature gains regenerate {1}{G}. ({1}{G}: The next time it would be destroyed this turn, instead tap it, remove all damage from it, and remove it from combat.)
flavor: He binds oak bark to a man's arm and calls it a blessing. It turns a blade well enough.

name: Wreath-Weaver Druid
text: Whenever a relic enters under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Wreath-Weaver Druid.
flavor: Wear one leaf and you are forgiven. Wear two and you are holy. (Wreath-Weaver Druid)

name: Wolfsire of the Fen
text: When Wolfsire of the Fen enters, create a 2/2 Wolf token.
flavor: Where he runs, he never runs alone.

name: Fowler of the Fens
text: Reach. When Fowler of the Fens enters, destroy target enemy creature with flying.
flavor: He reads the wind over the reed beds and knows where every wing will come down.

name: Stonehide Spirit
text: Reach. Regenerate {G}.
flavor: The stones remember every wrong, and forgive whoever brings them milk. (A saying of the Moot)

name: Spearman of the Greenwood
text: When Spearman of the Greenwood enters, target creature you control fights target enemy creature.
flavor: He calls the beasts of the wood to his side, and they settle the matter together.

name: Elder of the Oak Circle
text: When Elder of the Oak Circle enters, create a 1/1 Sapling token for each Druid you control (at most five).
flavor: We are not the masters of the wood. We are its weeds, and ought to apologise for it. (Elder of the Oak Circle)

name: Green Man of the Hedgerow

abilities.text: Tap: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

text: Tap: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
flavor: There is no sin but the axe, and no prayer but the rustle of leaves. (The druids' creed of the Green Man)

name: Rootbreaker Tusker
text: Trample. When Rootbreaker Tusker enters, destroy target enemy relic.
flavor: Palisades, siege towers, brass engines: all just more underbrush.

name: Woodwose of the Fells
text: Rooted: As long as you control six or more lands, Woodwose of the Fells gets +2/+2 and has trample.
flavor: Throw off your boots, your plough and your manners, says the wild man. He has no use for any of them, nor for soap.

name: Gift of the Greenwood
text: When Gift of the Greenwood enters, put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
flavor: The forest gives freely, says the Archdruid. He will tell you the price afterwards.

name: Trial by Tooth and Claw
text: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Then target creature you control fights target enemy creature.
flavor: Mercy is a sickness of the towns. The forest is healthy, and eats its young. (The Archdruid of the Moot)

name: Wassail the Orchard
text: Create two 1/1 Sapling tokens. Rooted: If you control six or more lands, create two more.
flavor: Cider on the roots, toast in the branches, and next year's apples heard every word.

name: Dowser's Hazel Rod
text: When Dowser's Hazel Rod enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Tap: Add {G}.
flavor: The river forgives every sin, so long as you confess it downstream of the village. (A dowser's saying)

name: Horn of the Wild Hunt
text: {2}{G}, Tap: Create a 2/2 Wolf token.
flavor: Blow it once on a winter night, and something in the hills always answers.

name: Pack-Leader of the Moors
text: Other Wolves you control get +1/+1.
flavor: He eats first, sleeps last, and every wolf on the moor knows his howl.

name: Old Grey Wolf
text: Whenever another Wolf enters under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Old Grey Wolf.
flavor: Every cub the pack raises makes him a little prouder, and a little more dangerous.

name: Old Moot-Oak
text: Other Treefolk you control get +1/+1.
flavor: The first law given under his boughs: the tree is holy and the woodcutter is damned. (Law of the Moot)

name: Acorn of the Elder Oak
text: Your Treefolk creature cards cost {1} less to play. This effect reduces only generic mana.
flavor: Plant it, and the wood will owe you a favour for three hundred years.

name: Pack Hunt
text: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Wolf you control. Then target creature you control fights target enemy creature.
flavor: The stag turned to face one wolf, and the other five did the rest.

name: Wolf-Pelt Mantle
text: When Wolf-Pelt Mantle enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. That creature gains trample. Create a 2/2 Wolf token.
flavor: The hill folk say the pack follows the man who wears its grey. The wolves have never said why.

name: Mantle-Keeper of the Circle
text: Your relic cards cost {1} less to play. This effect reduces only generic mana. As long as you control a relic, Mantle-Keeper of the Circle gets +1/+1.
flavor: He keeps the pelts, crowns and bark-cloths of the circle in an oak chest, and lends them out more freely than he ought.

name: Mistletoe Archdruid

abilities.text: {G}, Tap: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

text: At the beginning of your upkeep, add {G}. {G}, Tap: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
flavor: The Earth is our mother and our god, and she has asked me, personally, to collect the tithe. (Mistletoe Archdruid)

name: White Hart of the Greenwood
text: Regenerate {G}. Whenever White Hart of the Greenwood attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
flavor: To hunt the hart is murder, the druids teach. To hunt the hunter is merely housekeeping.

name: Antler-King of the Fens
text: Trample. Other Beasts you control get +1/+1.
flavor: Bow to the antlered king, the druids say, for he is a god. In the hungry winters the moot-folk call him venison.

name: Yew of a Thousand Winters
text: Reach. Regenerate {1}{G}. Rooted: As long as you control six or more lands, Yew of a Thousand Winters gets +3/+0.
flavor: Bury your dead beneath the yew and they become yew. That is all the heaven anyone needs. (Grey Elder of the Henge)

name: Fen-Worm of the Wear
text: Trample. Regenerate {1}{G}.
flavor: Cut it in two and throw half in the river. By morning it has found itself again.

name: Stampede of the Wild Hunt
text: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
flavor: Become the herd! Thinking was our first mistake, and together we shall undo it. (A Moot chant)

name: Hunter's Moon
text: Target creature you control fights target enemy creature. Rooted: If you control six or more lands, target creature you control then fights another target enemy creature.
flavor: Under the October moon the hunt rides twice before dawn.

name: Awaken the Grove
text: Create three 2/2 Oakling tokens with reach.
flavor: The trees have souls, the druids teach, and woodcutters do not. The trees agree.

name: Circle of Standing Stones
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, add {G}{G}.
flavor: Pray to the stones. In all these years they have never once contradicted a druid. (Grey Elder of the Henge)

name: Grey Sire of the Long Winter
text: Trample. Grey Sire of the Long Winter gets +1/+1 for each other Wolf you control.
flavor: In the hungry year he came down from the fells, and every wolf in the shire followed him.

name: Grandsire Hornbeam
text: Reach. Regenerate {1}{G}. Other Treefolk you control have reach and regenerate {1}{G}.
flavor: Ironwood, the charcoal burners call him, and they have broken three axes on his kin.

name: Grey Elder of the Henge
text: Grey Elder of the Henge gets +1/+1 for each other Druid you control. Whenever a relic enters under your control, create a 1/1 Sapling token.
flavor: His circle has kept its rites since before the first bell rang in the valley. He suspects the bell will outlast them.

name: Herne, Lord of the Wild Hunt
text: Trample. Whenever Herne attacks, create a 2/2 Wolf token.
flavor: Antlered and silent, he rides out from the old oak at midnight, and the wolves pour after him.

name: Cernoth, the Thousand-Year Oak
text: Trample, reach. When Cernoth enters, create two 2/2 Oakling tokens.
flavor: The druids worship him as god of the wood. He is a tree, and has never asked for any of it.

name: Wheel of the Year
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 Sapling token. Rooted: If you control six or more lands, also create a 3/3 Stag token.
flavor: Nothing is born, nothing dies, nothing is judged. Only the wheel turns, and the druid takes his cut. (Archdruid of the Moot)

name: Wolfwood, the Denning Oak
text: Trample. Other Treefolk you control get +1/+1. Other Wolves you control get +1/+1.
flavor: The wolves den among his roots, and the oaks of the wood stand taller for his shade.

name: Turn at Bay
text: Target creature you control fights target tapped enemy creature. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
flavor: The hunted boar turns on the hounds, and the druids call it justice. When the hounds win, they call that justice too.

name: Royal Elk of the Glen
text: Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the enemy player.)
flavor: The druids crowned him king of the glen. He ate the crown, which they took as a sign of great humility.

name: Barrow-Singer Druid
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, add {G} for each Druid you control.
flavor: Sing to the barrow and the ancestors will bless the barley. In three hundred years they have never once said no. (Barrow-Singer Druid)

name: Thunder-Split Ash
text: Trample. Other Treefolk you control have trample.
flavor: The storm god struck the ash to punish it, say the druids. The ash took it as encouragement.

name: Cave Bear of the Tors
text: Trample. When Cave Bear of the Tors enters, target creature you control fights target enemy creature.
flavor: Each spring the druids leave him honey and beg his blessing. He eats the honey, then the basket, and looks thoughtfully at the druid.

name: Ardagh, King of the Oakmoot
text: Trample. Other Treefolk you control get +2/+1 and have trample. When Ardagh enters, create a 2/2 Oakling token. Rooted: As long as you control six or more lands, Ardagh has regenerate {1}{G}.
flavor: Every king of men dies. Our king is a tree, so we shall be ruled forever, which is the same as being free. (A druid of the Moot)

name: Corrach, Archdruid of the Nine Stones
text: Other Druids you control get +1/+1. When Corrach enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Tap: Add {G}{G}.
flavor: Nine stones, nine winters, nine sacred mushrooms. I have seen the truth of the world, and it is mostly green. (Corrach)
